title_en: The Stance of Sunni Scholars on the Hadith That God Created Adam in His Image (Part 1)
description_en: The stance of Sunni scholars on the hadith that God created Adam in his image, Part 1. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: This lecture discusses how Sunni scholars interpret and approach the hadith concerning the creation of Adam in the divine image.
